title: 3.76 crore rural women just crossed a lakh rupees a year in household income
sources: YourStory, November 2026 - 3 crore+ women Lakhpati Didis under the Centre's rural livelihoods initiative
ProKerala/IANS, November 2026 - Government factsheet on Lakhpati Didi scheme progress
caption:
A 'Lakhpati Didi' is a rural woman whose household income crosses one lakh rupees a year. As of this year, that's no longer a rare story - it's 3.76 crore of them.

3.76 crore rural self-help group women have now reached Lakhpati Didi status, as of June 2026. The self-help group network behind this has grown to over 10 crore members across 94.4 lakh groups nationwide.

The government's target is 6 crore Lakhpati Didis by March 2029 - meaning this milestone is already past halfway there.

This isn't one success story. It's 3.76 crore of them, counted one household at a time.
